ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, estimated at approximately 0.15:1, characterized by a salt-and-pepper distribution of light spots on a dark background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity field across both lobes. High-intensity (white) pixels are mapped as small, discrete, roughly circular blobs across the entire visible surface. Larger, contiguous high-intensity clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. A distinct vertical dark-intensity linear band is mapped on the medial-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregularity with pixel-amplitude variations of +/- 5-15 pixels. The left lobe trailing edge displays 4-5 distinct peaks. The right lobe tip terminates in a complex, multi-peaked, irregular protrusion with high topographic variance.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The upper boundary follows a broadly convex curve from the central notch toward the tips, interrupted by significant geometric jaggedness at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial detection of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the dark ventral field, with higher density along the central fluke stem and inner lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruption (dark against dark-grey) located on the left lobe; multiple faint, horizontal linear streaks are detected on the lower stem portion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular, high-contrast white textured masses (likely barnacle colonization or significant trauma) at both lobe tips. A secondary deep indentation/notch is visible on the right lobe trailing edge immediately adjacent to the median notch. Prominent vertical scar on left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of dense white spotting ('salt and pepper' pattern) and the extreme, cauliflower-like structural deformation at the distal tips.
